video.title: Global Queue, Asynchronous Call & Synchronous Call | Day 252
video.description:
Learn to explain the difference between waiting and not waiting for work: Global Queue, Asynchronous Call & Synchronous Call, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Global Queue - A queue that the system provides and shares with every app, ready to use.
Asynchronous Call - A call that returns right away and lets the work finish later.
Synchronous Call - A call that makes the caller wait until the work is finished.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 252 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS Global Queue, Asynchronous Call & Synchronous Call | Day 252
landscape.description:
Explain Global Queue, Asynchronous Call & Synchronous Call in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Global Queue, Asynchronous Call, Synchronous Call 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Global Queue - A queue that the system provides and shares with every app, ready to use.
한국어: Global Queue: 시스템이 제공하고 모든 앱이 공유하는, 바로 쓸 수 있는 큐

Asynchronous Call - A call that returns right away and lets the work finish later.
한국어: Asynchronous Call: 바로 반환되고 작업은 나중에 끝나도록 두는 호출

Synchronous Call - A call that makes the caller wait until the work is finished.
한국어: Synchronous Call: 작업이 끝날 때까지 호출한 쪽이 기다리게 하는 호출

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about a screen that freezes because of a call that waits, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Global Queue, Asynchronous Call and Synchronous Call in English?

dialogue.title: The frozen screen
dialogue.setting: An app that freezes while saving

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My screen freezes when I save a big file. I think my code is fine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let me see. You wrote `q.sync`. That is a synchronous call, so the caller waits until the work is finished.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But I use a global queue, so it should run in the background.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A global queue is a shared queue from the system, but a synchronous call still blocks you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So what should I use instead?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An asynchronous call. It returns right away and lets the work finish later.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Use `q.async` and the screen stays smooth.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Wait, will the file be saved before the screen updates?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, and that is fine. An asynchronous call does not promise that.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. I will use a global queue with an asynchronous call.
